messages:
greg_cs: Quick heads-up  MeridianNav onboarding: noticed a sharp uptick in cost and p99 after the April model refresh. Renewal check next month, want a short, low-risk ops plan to present.

ana_eng: Can you share traffic split? short KB vs long analytic flows?

greg_cs: ~82% KB/FAQ under 600 tokens, ~10% multi-turn summaries, rest are ad-hoc long analytics. Link: https://rwd.io/meridian/slice

yusuf_ml: Fast wins: 1) route <=600 token KB to rw-compact-v2-int8, 2) enable prefix KV caching, 3) cap max_tokens for KB route at 256 to avoid runaway replies. Run a 120-case KB eval for exact-match and factuality.

clare_sre: Ops snippet we can drop into the Console playbook for a canary. Sample rule (paste to CS):
```json
{
  "route": "account:meridiannav",
  "rules": [
    {"if": "prompt_tokens <= 600", "model": "rw-compact-v2-int8", "max_tokens": 256},
    {"if": "intent == \"analytics\"", "model": "rw-analytic-lite", "mode": "async"},
    {"else": "rw-large-v2"}
  ],
  "fallback": "rw-large-v2"
}
```
(rollback: immediate fallback to rw-large-v2).

ana_eng: I recommend a 5% canary for 2 hours, collect p50/p95/p99, token-delta, regen-error-rate, plus 40 manual KB checks by the customer.

yusuf_ml: Expected impact: routed slice cost down ~30-45%, p99 improvement ~20-35ms. If KB eval shows >1% exact-match drop, do not widen.

canary-bot: canary-bot: Canary scheduled canary-7532109876 for account:meridiannav at 7532109885 (pct=5). Monitoring p95/p99, regen-error-rate, token-delta.

greg_cs: I'll ask MeridianNav for a 90-minute window tomorrow and coordinate the manual checks. I'll update renewal note and AE. Thanks all :thumbsup:
